items.source: By default, XStream does not require any further configuration and can (un)marshal any class on the classpath. As such, it is not recommended to use the XStreamMarshaller to unmarshal XML from external sources (i.e. the Web), as this can result in security vulnerabilities. If you do use the XStreamMarshaller to unmarshal external XML, set the supportedClasses and converters properties (possibly using a CatchAllConverter) or override the customizeXStream(XStream) method to make sure it only accepts the classes you want it to support.
items.translation: 默认情况下，XStream 不需要任何进一步配置即可在类路径上 (反) 序列化任何类。因此，不建议使用 XStreamMarshaller 从外部来源（例如 Web）反序列化 XML，因为这可能导致 安全漏洞。如果您确实使用 XStreamMarshaller 反序列化外部 XML，请设置 supportedClasses 和 converters 属性（可能使用 CatchAllConverter），或重写 customizeXStream(XStream) 方法，以确保它仅接受您希望其支持的类。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.0, the default HierarchicalStreamDriver is a DomDriver that uses the configured encoding and NameCoder. The driver can be changed via setStreamDriver(HierarchicalStreamDriver).
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，默认的 `HierarchicalStreamDriver`>是一个使用配置的encoding和NameCoder的`DomDriver`。可以通过setStreamDriver(HierarchicalStreamDriver)更改该驱动程序。

items.source: Due to XStream's API, it is required to set the encoding used for writing to OutputStreams. It defaults to UTF-8.
items.translation: 由于 XStream 的 API，必须设置用于写入 OutputStream 的编码。其默认值为 `UTF-8`。

items.source: NOTE: XStream is an XML serialization library, not a data binding library. Therefore, it has limited namespace support. As such, it is rather unsuitable for usage within Web Services.
items.translation: 注意：XStream 是一个 XML 序列化库，而非数据绑定库。因此，其命名空间支持有限，不太适合在 Web 服务中使用。

items.source: As of Spring 4.0, this stream driver will also be passed to the XStream constructor and therefore used by streaming-related native API methods themselves.
items.translation: 自 Spring 4.0 起，此流驱动也将传递给 `XStream` 构造函数，因此将由流相关的本机 API 方法自身使用。

items.source: Keys are aliases; values are either Class instances, or String class names.

items.source: Note: Autodetection implies that the XStream instance is being configured while it is processing the XML streams, and thus introduces a potential concurrency problem.

items.source: This marshaller requires XStream 1.4.7 or higher.
items.translation: 此反序列化器需要 XStream 1.4.7 或更高版本。

items.source: If this property is empty (the default), all classes are supported.
items.translation: 如果该属性为空（默认值），则支持所有类。

items.source:

unmarshalling, since XStream itself does not make this distinction in its exception hierarchy.

items.source: Set the types to use XML attributes for. The given map can contain either <String, Class> pairs, in which case XStream.useAttributeFor(String, Class) is called. Alternatively, the map can contain <Class, String> or <Class, List<String>> pairs, which results in XStream.useAttributeFor(Class, String) calls.
items.translation: 设置要使用 XML 属性的类型。给定的 Map 可以包含 `<String, Class>` 对，此时将调用 `XStream.useAttributeFor(String, Class)`；或者，该 Map 可以包含 `<Class, String>` 或 `<Class, List<String>>` 对，这将导致调用 `XStream.useAttributeFor(Class, String)`。

items.source: Set XStream type permissions such as AnyTypePermission, ExplicitTypePermission etc, as an alternative to overriding the customizeXStream(XStream) method.
